title: The iOS repos pin the same runner and build in Swift 6
why: Your comments on the iOS kit page, Oct 27 (https://claude.ai/artifact/36CtFQ6CaTszMaxxZvuCXq).
note: Deferred (shiv, Oct 27): both touch child repos, so each waits on your plan check. (1) home-app CI pins macos-latest; pin macos-26 like mailaudit and ios-adblock, so Xcode cannot change without warning (checked home-app 360a31f). (2) ios-adblock builds in Swift 5.0 language mode; the other three use 6.0, which checks data races at build time. It has 6 Swift files, so move it the next time its app code is touched (checked ios-adblock 78fb749). Not worth matching: XCTest against Swift Testing, and XcodeGen against a committed project. Port: no; per repo. Placed after c89, ahead of c54 (triage, Oct 27): same iOS cleanup.
